# sophosfirewall_mac_address (Resource)

Manages a MAC address object (*Objects > Hosts and services > MAC host*). Set exactly one of `mac_address` or `mac_addresses`; switching between them recreates the object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sophosfirewall_mac_address" "printer" {
  name        = "office-printer"
  mac_address = "00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e"
}

resource "sophosfirewall_mac_address" "kiosks" {
  name          = "kiosks"
  mac_addresses = ["00:1a:2b:3c:4d:01", "00:1a:2b:3c:4d:02"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the MAC address object.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `mac_address` (String) A single MAC address, e.g. `00:1a:2b:3c:4d:5e`.
- `mac_addresses` (Set of String) A list of MAC addresses (up to 1000).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_mac_address.example <name-or-uuid>
```
